messages:
maria-s: Heads-up — we're scheduling a small runtime/kernel tweak for Dedicated GPUs next Wednesday at 09:00 UTC (change window 09:00–09:30 UTC). Goal: mitigate a rare OOM regression for long KV-cache sessions. Will cause short rolling restarts (2–5min per node). Need: status page blurb + customer email template + any redlines from support/eng.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: runtime-kernel-1.6.2 -> canary on nodepool-dedicated-3 at 08:45 UTC, global rollout 09:00 UTC. Canary health checks: PASS.

samir-eng: +1 on the schedule. Canary looked fine locally for 12h, but we saw a single degraded trace at seq_len 8192 on canary node — investigating. If that repeats we should hold.

chloe-cs: I can draft the customer email. Two asks: 1) reassure about short interruption, 2) list SLA impact (none expected). Also want a one-line to paste into status page.

emily-pm: Decision: proceed if canary stays green until 08:55 UTC. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to runtime-kernel-1.6.1 and pin dedicated customers still on their previous variant for 24h if we see regression. Notify customers with [dedicated] tag 10 minutes before.

maria-s: Good. Chloe — can you put both a short status blurb and a slightly longer email draft here? Include contact link and optional opt-out for customers on pinned versions.

chloe-cs: Sure — initial drafts below. Feedback welcome.

chloe-cs: Status page short blurb (to use on status.redwood.com):
```
We will perform a routine runtime upgrade for Dedicated GPU capacity on Wed, YYYY-MM-DD 09:00 UTC. Expected user impact: short, rolling restarts per node (2–5 minutes) which may briefly affect latency for active requests. No data loss expected. If you rely on pinned versions, no automatic migration will occur.
```

chloe-cs: Expanded customer email (HTML/plain combined):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — short Dedicated runtime upgrade (YYYY-MM-DD, 09:00 UTC)

Hello,

We are rolling out a small runtime kernel update to Dedicated GPU pools to address a rare out-of-memory condition for very long sequences. The maintenance window is Wed, YYYY-MM-DD from 09:00–09:30 UTC. During this time you may experience short rolling restarts on affected nodes (2–5 minutes per node).

What to expect:
- No changes to API surface or request semantics.
- Short latency spikes while an active node is restarted; requests will reroute to healthy capacity when possible.
- No user data will be deleted.

If you have pinned a model/runtime version, you will not be migrated automatically. To stay on the previous runtime, reply to this email with: "please pin runtime-kernel-1.6.1 for my account" and we will arrange it.

If you need to opt out of the update, contact support@redwood.ai or open a support ticket before 08:50 UTC on the day of the maintenance.

Release notes: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/runtime-kernel-1.6.2

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support
```

samir-eng: That reads fine. Two more tech bullets for release notes — can we add:
- Fix: KV-cache refcount leak for long context sequences (>65k tokens)
- Performance: ~4% lower p99 memory under heavy KV reuse

nate-ds: Add a short data note: customers running offline batch embeddings may see jobs retried if the node restarts mid-job; recommend checkpointing/sharding long jobs.

maria-s: Fine. Emily — confirm the 08:55 canary cutoff and notify plan.

emily-pm: Confirmed. Canary cutoff 08:55 UTC. Notification sequence: 08:40 internal reminder, 08:50 customer pre-notify (dedicated tag), 09:00 start rollout, 09:30 expected complete. If canary fails before 08:55 we hold and update status with 'Investigating - canary failure'.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: post message to #announcements at 08:50 UTC. Will also create a Statuspage incident in maintenance mode if rollout starts.

maria-s: One more: include the opt-out pin command for self-serve API teams — short snippet for customer-facing docs.

chloe-cs: Snippet to include in docs/email: `To pin runtime: POST /v1/accounts/{acct}/pin-runtime {"runtime":"runtime-kernel-1.6.1"}`

incident-bot: Status incident created: INC-2026-1780 (maintenance scheduled) — will update to 'identified' when rollout begins.

samir-eng: Quick note: if we see the seq_len 8192 regression again during canary, plan = abort, rollback 1.6.1, and run a targeted hotfix patch. Also call out customers on very long sessions — we should notify them separately.

chloe-cs: I'll add a short targeted note for customers with long KV sessions and start an outreach list.

maria-s: Thanks team. Chloe — please post final drafts here by EOD today. I'll merge to status and schedule the email send tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

chloe-cs: Will do. Posting final copy by 17:00 PT.

maria-s: Closing thread for now — follow-ups in the customer-outreach doc if needed.
